visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a circular, crispy golden-brown potato pizza resting on brown parchment paper with herbs. A man with dark shoulder-length hair wearing a striped t-shirt is at the bottom, speaking with high energy. (2) Hands are shown in a close-up using a green plastic grater to shred a large potato into a clear glass bowl on a countertop. (3) The shredded potatoes are agitated in a bowl of clear water by hands to remove starch, creating white froth on the surface. (4) Hands press the shredded potatoes against a metal mesh strainer over a glass bowl to drain all excess liquid. (5) Liquid oil and white flour are poured from containers onto the pile of drained potato shreds in the bowl. (6) A block of Halloumi cheese is grated over the mixture using the same green grater; the white cheese flakes cover the flour. (7) Salt, pepper, and green herbs are sprinkled on top, and a wooden spoon stirs the ingredients into a thick, uniform paste. (8) The mixture is spread onto a round baking tray and flattened with a spoon; olive oil is then drizzled in a circular pattern over the top. (9) A hand places the tray into a modern silver oven; the digital display and control knobs are clearly visible. (10) The finished dish is garnished with more cheese and herbs; the man is then shown eating a slice and talking to the camera with various hand gestures.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 國外爆紅 馬鈴薯披薩. [Slogan]: HALLOUMI POTATO SCARPACCIA. (2) [Subtitle]: 馬鈴薯洗乾淨後 刨成粗絲. (3) [Subtitle]: 放入冷水攪動30秒 去除多餘的澱粉. (4) [Subtitle]: 瀝乾馬鈴薯絲的水份. (5) [Subtitle]: 加入水、油、麵粉. (6) [Subtitle]: 刨好的哈魯米起司 (好市多買得到). (7) [Subtitle]: 加入鹽、黑胡椒、巴西里 攪拌均勻. (8) [Subtitle]: 倒入烤盤鋪平 再淋上一點橄欖油. (9) [Subtitle]: 180度烤40分鐘. (10) [Subtitle]: 新鮮的起司、巴西里 點綴做裝飾. (11) [Subtitle]: 完成了. [Variety]: 超大一個. (12) [Variety]: 好脆喔. (13) [Subtitle]: 吃起來像披薩. (14) [Subtitle]: 加了麵粉和馬鈴薯 越嚼馬鈴薯越香. (15) [Subtitle]: 像是吃巨大化 披薩口感的薯餅. (16) [Subtitle]: 我覺得可以把它當基底. (17) [Subtitle]: 你今天不想擀披薩皮 又想自製披薩. (18) [Subtitle]: 用馬鈴薯可以做出來. (19) [Subtitle]: 上面再放你自己喜歡吃的料. (20) [Variety]: 香腸.
